# Vendored algo-derm

`algo-derm.tgz` is the frozen v35 package integrated locally on 2026-10-31.
It is a backend dependency; npm version `0.3.2` does not identify its contents.

| Identifier | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Tag contract | 35 |
| Size | 890709 bytes |
| SHA-256 | `deaf1d4f21bae67446611dea131062d2c8b1510e46d5a71bf8c4444afc3699bc` |
| Upstream base commit | `dbf47c4eb956b3522b09804bb12d87edb405c103` |
| Source state | Frozen v34 source plus the governed Polybutene alias correction, generated data, tests and contract documentation |

The base commit alone cannot reproduce this package. Use these exact tarball bytes
and the matching `bun.lock` integrity. The host and dev API are checked against every
packaged file.

`just vendor-algo-derm` still defaults to the historical `v42-aurore` pin, contract
24. Do not use that rebuild recipe to reproduce v35. A future source rebuild needs
a matching immutable upstream pin and qualification before replacing this artifact.

Version 35 preserves Polybutene as a separate declaration and stops assigning it
Polyisobutene evidence or concentration bounds. No Polybutene evidence profile is
invented. Polyisobutene retains canonical spelling and its existing evidence;
Hydrogenated Polyisobutene remains distinct. Version 34 CI annotation handling and
all thresholds remain unchanged.

The four Summer Fridays sources were subsequently applied in dev after a fresh
preflight. Scoped reconciliation removed seven automatic ingredient links
(three UV-filter links and four Polyisobutene links) and one automatic tag on Cherry.
Human curation was preserved; repeat plans converge and both snapshots were verified.

Installing this package does not refresh persisted tags, ingredient links or profiles.
The source application was a separately authorized operation. Conditional citrus diagnostics
remain unused by Aurore. Technical verification does not validate provisional models.
